rationale: This PR materializes static MLT extended-media and provider-neutral digital-human contracts, a non-admitted HeyGen provider projection, a HyperFrames architecture-pattern usage edge, registry/distribution bindings, static planning/runtime-denial helpers, tests and CI gates. It does not admit or activate a provider/model/runtime, add a host service, mutate host packages or environment, open a port/socket, consume hardware or HRB resources, alter Current Host execution/evidence semantics, or claim Current Host/runtime promotion. Therefore the structural change requires documentation and fail-closed coverage but no physical Current Host requalification.
